item.bleach.sanrei_glove.desc: A Quincy's training glove. Every draw fights it.
tooltip.bleach.shihakusho_set: Full Shihakushō: +%s%% reiryoku regeneration for Shinigami and Academy students
tooltip.bleach.denreishinki: Beeps when a Garganta opens nearby. Use it to find the nearest Hollow
tooltip.bleach.hell_butterfly: A Hell Butterfly. It guides the Shinigami who carries it through a Senkaimon
tooltip.bleach.quincy_cross: Hold use to draw a bow of reishi. It answers only to Quincy blood
tooltip.bleach.quincy_garb_set: Full Quincy garb: +%s%% reishi gathering for Quincy
tooltip.bleach.mask_fragment: A shard of a Hollow's mask, still heavy with its reiatsu.
tooltip.bleach.hollow_bait: Crush it to draw Hollows here for up to %s minutes.
tooltip.bleach.arrancar_blade: The torn piece of a Hollow's mask, become a blade. Its owner's power sleeps in it.
tooltip.bleach.wandenreich_cap: Part of the Wandenreich uniform. Only for the look.
tooltip.bleach.arrancar_uniform: Part of the white Arrancar uniform. Only for the look.
tooltip.bleach.caja_negacion: Slip it into a Hollow hole, from behind.

screen.bleach.soul.reiatsu.released: Reiatsu released. Press %s to hold it in

screen.bleach.soul.bait: Hollow Bait: %s crushed, %s finales; contests won %s, lost %s
screen.bleach.soul.zanpakuto.settling: sealed, %s before it can be released
screen.bleach.soul.takeover.near_death: Inner Hollow: may seize you near death
screen.bleach.soul.takeover.last: Lose to it once more and it takes you

screen.bleach.soul.quincy.sealed: Power sealed: %s until it can return
screen.bleach.soul.next.human: You are alive and can sense spirits. Grow your reiryoku; a Shinigami in need may one day share their power with you. If you die, your soul lingers as a Plus.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.latent: Quincy blood runs in you. Hold use with a Quincy Cross to draw on the reishi around you, or meditate with it in hand, and keep at it (near a Hollow, if you dare) until a bow of light forms.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.1: You are a Quincy. Your Cross forms the Heilig Bogen: hold use to draw, let go to fire. Meditate with the Cross in hand to gather reishi, and destroy Hollows to grow stronger.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.2: Reishi carries you now: the Flash Step key does Hirenkyaku, and you can stand on reishi in mid-air. Call on Blut with its key, and fill empty Gintō with reishi to cast Gritz and Wolke.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.3: Your arrows pierce deep. Wear the Sanrei Glove and train through its strain on seven separate days. Beware Hollow poison.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.glove: The Sanrei Glove fights every draw. Earn a day's training with it on seven separate days (full draws, Hollow hits, destroyed Hollows) to master it.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.glove_mas: The glove is mastered. Tear it off with the Quincy Form key, pressed twice, to burn your power out in Letzt Stil, once and for good.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.letzt_sti: Your power is burning out. Spend it well before it is gone.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.sealed: Your power is sealed. Give it time; Gintō you filled before still work.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.sealed_re: Your power can return: worn to near collapse, hold the Cross through the rite where reishi is not thin, or have another Quincy's full-draw arrow find the place beside your heart.
Your power can return: worn to near collapse, have another Quincy's full-draw arrow find the place beside your heart.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.restored: Ginrei Kojaku is yours: stream arrows, call Licht Regen, form Seele Schneider and set them off with Sprenger. Keep training to reach your full form.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.vollstand: Your full form is within reach: press the Quincy Form key for Vollständig, and sneak while pressing it for Sklaverei.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.poisoned: Hollow reiatsu is poisoning your soul. Rest and gather reishi where it runs rich, or stand by while a Shinigami purifies a Hollow, before it tears you apart.
screen.bleach.soul.next.substitute: You are a Substitute Shinigami: alive, with a Shinigami's power. Perform Konsō on Pluses, train your Hohō for Shunpo, and bond with your Asauchi.
screen.bleach.soul.next.substitute.bonde: Your Asauchi is ready to speak. On solid ground, sneak and hold use with it to sit in Jinzen.
screen.bleach.soul.next.substitute.named: Call your zanpakutō's name with the Release key to enter Shikai, and keep the town's Pluses safe.
screen.bleach.soul.next.plus: Your Chain of Fate is wearing away. Find a Shinigami to perform Konsō before it runs out.
screen.bleach.soul.next.plus.academy: Your Chain of Fate holds here in Soul Society: ask the Academy's instructor for Konsō.
screen.bleach.soul.next.plus.duty: Or wait for a Shinigami on duty to come to you.
screen.bleach.soul.next.plus.elsewhere: Your Chain of Fate is wearing away. A Shinigami must perform Konsō before it runs out: find one here, or return to the Overworld, where one on duty will come to you.
screen.bleach.soul.next.plus.gnaw: Or hold %s to gnaw the chain away yourself, and become a Hollow.
screen.bleach.soul.next.plus.holds: Your Chain of Fate holds in this world. Find a Shinigami to perform Konsō.
screen.bleach.soul.next.plus.holds.duty: Your Chain of Fate holds in this world, but no Shinigami on duty comes here: find one, or return to the Overworld, where one will come to you.
screen.bleach.soul.next.rukongai: You have passed on. Souls with spiritual power can enroll at the Academy to train as Shinigami.
screen.bleach.soul.next.quincy.rukongai: You have passed on, but you are a Quincy: the Academy will not take you, and your power sleeps while you are a spirit.
screen.bleach.soul.next.student: Train the Zankensoki, then ask the Academy instructor to examine you for graduation.
screen.bleach.soul.next.student.bonded: Your Asauchi has a voice, but you must graduate before you can hear its name.
screen.bleach.soul.next.lent: Your power flowed into a human. It will return in time.
screen.bleach.soul.next.shinigami: Bond with your Asauchi until it tells you its name.
screen.bleach.soul.next.shinigami.bonded: Your Asauchi is ready to speak. On solid ground, sneak and hold use with it to sit in Jinzen.
screen.bleach.soul.next.shinigami.named: Call your zanpakutō's name with the Release key to enter Shikai.
screen.bleach.soul.next.hollowfied: A Hollow has taken root in your wounds. Give it a day, then sit in Jinzen and face it.
screen.bleach.soul.next.hollowfied.waiti: Your Hollow beat you. Rest, and face it again in Jinzen once it stirs.
screen.bleach.soul.next.hollowfied.ready: Your Hollow is waiting. Sit in Jinzen and beat it to make its mask your own.
screen.bleach.soul.next.visored: Your Hollow is beaten, and its mask is yours. Press the Hollow Mask key to call it: it lasts only seconds at first, and longer the more you wear it.
screen.bleach.soul.next.hollow: You are a Hollow, and the hunger never ends. Weaken a soul and hold %s to devour it: a Plus at once, a Hollow or an aware player once badly hurt. Your claws strike bare-handed. If you would be a soul again, kneel before the Academy's instructor.
screen.bleach.soul.next.hollow.fed: Keep devouring with %s: %s souls are within you now, and the greatest Hollows are made of thousands. A Shinigami's blade, or the Academy's instructor, can still cleanse you.
screen.bleach.soul.next.hollow.gillian: You are a Gillian, one face among the countless souls fused within you, your mind clouded by them. Devour with %1$s, other Menos above all, and gather a Cero with %2$s. Since you rose you have devoured %3$s of the %4$s Hollows and %5$s of the %6$s Menos a will needs to rise above the rest and become an Adjuchas.
screen.bleach.soul.next.hollow.gillian.l: You are a Gillian, and the will that once rose above the souls within you has drowned for good. Devour with %1$s and gather a Cero with %2$s.
screen.bleach.soul.next.hollow.gillian.n: Look at a hurt comrade and press %s to call down Negación and lift them away.
screen.bleach.soul.next.hollow.adjuchas: You are an Adjuchas, your own will won back from the souls within you. Devour with %1$s and gather a Cero with %2$s. Since you rose you have devoured %3$s of the %4$s Hollows and %5$s of the %6$s Adjuchas that could make you more.
You are an Adjuchas, and this soul will grow no further. Devour with %1$s and gather a Cero with %2$s.
You are an Adjuchas with all it takes to become a Vasto Lorde, but Hueco Mundo holds as many as it can bear. Devour with %1$s and gather a Cero with %2$s.
Without a Hollow, you sink back into a Gillian. Minutes of play left: %s.
screen.bleach.soul.next.hollow.vasto_lor: You are a Vasto Lorde, one of the rarest Hollows of all, as strong as a captain of the Gotei 13 and free of the Adjuchas's need to keep devouring. Gather a Cero with %1$s.
screen.bleach.soul.next.hollow.tear: Press %s twice to tear off your mask and become an Arrancar: it may fail, and there is no going back.
screen.bleach.soul.next.arrancar: Your Hollow power is sealed in %1$s. Hold it and press %2$s to call out its release, and %3$s to seal it again. Gather a Cero with %4$s.
screen.bleach.soul.next.arrancar.arts: Sonído: %1$s. Bala: %2$s (hold to keep firing). Pesquisa: hold %3$s still. Hierro turns aside %4$s%% of an equal's blow.
screen.bleach.soul.next.arrancar.gran_re: Gran Rey Cero: sneak and hold %1$s with your blade in hand, or released. It spills %2$s hearts of your blood and %3$s reiryoku, and the next waits %4$s seconds.
Gran Rey Cero is the Espada's alone: a seat needs %1$s maximum reiryoku (you have %2$s) and a place among the ten strongest Arrancar.

screen.bleach.bloodline.body: Quincy are born, not made: their power comes down the blood, pure (Echt) or mixed (Gemischt). Is there Quincy blood in you? You are asked once, and it cannot be changed.
screen.bleach.bloodline.human.tooltip: No Quincy blood. Your soul may still find another path
screen.bleach.bloodline.quincy.tooltip: Quincy blood, Echt about one time in four. A Quincy Cross awakens it. An awakened Quincy cannot take a Shinigami's power
screen.bleach.bloodline.fate.tooltip: A small chance of Quincy blood
jinzen.bleach.silent: You sit with the Asauchi across your knees. For now it is only steel.
jinzen.bleach.stirring: Something in the blade turns towards you, then away again.
jinzen.bleach.stirring.name: It tries to tell you its name: %s
jinzen.bleach.vision.power: You glimpse something huge and patient, all muscle and teeth.
jinzen.bleach.vision.kido: You glimpse a cold light that bends the air around it.
jinzen.bleach.vision.constant_release: You glimpse a wind that never stops blowing.
jinzen.bleach.student: A voice speaks from the blade, but a student's soul cannot hold its name yet. Graduate, then come back.
jinzen.bleach.weak: The voice is there, but too faint to follow. Grow your maximum reiryoku to %s and come back.
jinzen.bleach.resting: The spirit has turned its back on you. Come back in %s.
jinzen.bleach.unknown: The world inside the blade is empty. Whatever lived here is gone.
jinzen.bleach.ribbons: Among the white ribbons, one is red: the one that is yours. Take hold of it.
jinzen.bleach.fangs: The jaws close around you. Strike through the gap before they meet.
jinzen.bleach.reveal.name: Its name is %s.
jinzen.bleach.reveal.constant: It has no command. Once you call its name, it will never seal again.
jinzen.bleach.fail.retry: The world fades. You may try again in %s.
zanpakuto.bleach.zangetsu.intro.1: You stand on the wall of a tower. The whole city lies on its side under a pale sky.
zanpakuto.bleach.zangetsu.intro.2: An old man in a long black coat stands on a flagpole, his coat moving in a wind you cannot feel.
zanpakuto.bleach.zangetsu.intro.3: He looks at you as if he has been waiting for years.
zanpakuto.bleach.zangetsu.question: Something stronger than you is coming. What do you do?
zanpakuto.bleach.zangetsu.reveal.1: He nods, and the wind over the city falls still.
zanpakuto.bleach.zangetsu.fail.1: The old man turns away. Rain begins to fall on the city.
zanpakuto.bleach.zangetsu.visit.1: The old man watches the sky. He says nothing, and does not need to.
zanpakuto.bleach.zabimaru.intro.1: Thick jungle presses in on every side, loud with insects and running water.
zanpakuto.bleach.zabimaru.intro.2: A great baboon watches you from the branches, and a snake coils where its tail should be.
zanpakuto.bleach.zabimaru.question: Someone you look up to is far ahead of you. What do you want?
zanpakuto.bleach.zabimaru.reveal.1: The baboon laughs, and the snake hisses along with it.
zanpakuto.bleach.zabimaru.fail.1: The baboon loses interest and climbs away into the canopy.
zanpakuto.bleach.zabimaru.visit.1: The baboon dozes in the branches. The snake opens one eye.

screen.bleach.dialogue.instructor.living: The Academy trains the souls of the departed, and you still have a body. Some say a Shinigami can pour their power into one of the living. Central 46 executes any Shinigami who does, so do not go looking for one.
screen.bleach.dialogue.instructor.substi: So you are the human who took a Shinigami's power. There is nothing here you would be allowed to learn, but I can spare you a blade.
screen.bleach.dialogue.instructor.plus: Your Chain of Fate still binds you. Before you can study here your soul must pass on. Shall I perform Konsō?
screen.bleach.dialogue.instructor.soul: You have passed on, and you have spiritual power. The Academy teaches the Zankensoki: Zanjutsu, Hakuda, Hohō and Kidō. Will you enroll?
screen.bleach.dialogue.instructor.studen: Train the four arts, then sit the exams. Kidō is learned by casting: call a spell by its number and name, and it answers better each time.
screen.bleach.dialogue.instructor.shinig: A Shinigami. Your division needs you more than I do.
screen.bleach.dialogue.instructor.hollow: A Hollow, at the Academy? Leave now, before I cut you down.
A Hollow, at the Academy... and you came to me instead of to the souls in the town. Kneel, and my blade will cleanse you. It will hurt.
screen.bleach.dialogue.instructor.quincy: A Quincy. Your kind destroys the souls we are sworn to send on. There is nothing for you here, and the Academy wants no trouble with you.
screen.bleach.dialogue.wounded.offer_pow: A Hollow did this. I drove it off, but I cannot fight like this, and it will be back. You can see me, so you have the strength for this. Take my power. It is forbidden, but I see no other way.
screen.bleach.dialogue.wounded.plus: Your chain is wearing thin. Let me send you on while I still can.
screen.bleach.dialogue.wounded.resting: I will mend. Go, before the Hollow returns.
screen.bleach.dialogue.wounded.quincy: A Quincy... Your soul would never take my power, and I would not give it to you. Go, before the Hollow comes back.
screen.bleach.dialogue.duty.plus: I was sent for you. Your chain is wearing away. Let me send you on before it is gone.
screen.bleach.dialogue.duty.resting: I came for a soul still bound to this world. You are not the one I was sent for.
screen.bleach.dialogue.duty.hollow: A Hollow, here? Come no closer, or my blade will answer.
screen.bleach.dialogue.elder.elder_greet: So you are the one with our blood. Your stance is sloppy. I will teach you, a little each day, if you have the patience for it.
screen.bleach.dialogue.elder.elder_lesso: Again. Draw from the air around you, not from your arms.
screen.bleach.dialogue.elder.elder_teach: There is a way to fight on when the body has nothing left: threads of reishi, pulling the limbs like a puppet's. I will bind you. Free yourself with the threads.
screen.bleach.dialogue.elder.elder_trial: The threads. Sneak, and call your form. Move with reishi alone.
screen.bleach.dialogue.elder.elder_resto: You burned your power away. It can be brought back, by an arrow just beside the heart, but only from a body at the end of its strength.
screen.bleach.dialogue.elder.elder_stran: You have nothing of ours in you. Go home.
screen.bleach.dialogue.elder.elder_hollo: I do not speak with Hollows.
screen.bleach.dialogue.hunter.hunter_cha: A Shinigami, here? Fine. Let's settle which of us protects this town better: whoever destroys more Hollows.
screen.bleach.dialogue.hunter.hunter_riv: You call yourself a Quincy? Prove it. Whoever destroys more Hollows.
screen.bleach.dialogue.hunter.hunter_pla: You shouldn't be out here. Go home.
screen.bleach.dialogue.hunter.hunter_hol: One more step and I'll shoot.
screen.bleach.dialogue.action.restore: Ask him to restore your power
screen.bleach.dialogue.asauchi_not_ready: Only for a soul with no blade, once every ten minutes
screen.bleach.dialogue.ransotengai_not_r: You are not ready for the trial now.
screen.bleach.dialogue.restore_not_ready: Only a power long sealed, in a body at the end of its strength, can take it.
screen.bleach.dialogue.butterfly_not_rea: Only for one who carries none, once a day
message.bleach.became_plus: Your body is gone. You linger where you fell, a Plus bound to this world by your Chain of Fate.
message.bleach.became_plus.elsewhere: Your body is gone, and you could not stay where you fell. You wake as a Plus, bound to this world by your Chain of Fate.
message.bleach.encroachment_begins: The links of your Chain of Fate have begun to eat each other. Encroachment has set in.
message.bleach.encroachment_pang: Your chain gnaws at your chest
message.bleach.hollowfied: Your Chain of Fate is gone. A hole opens in your chest and a mask forms over your face. You have become a Hollow.
message.bleach.hollow_player.hint: Hunger burns where your heart was. Weaken a soul and hold %s to devour it. A Plus cannot fight back.
message.bleach.hollow_player.sight.on: Your eyes find the dark again.
message.bleach.hollow_player.sight.off: You let the dark close in.
message.bleach.hollow_player.shed: Your hide will not bear armour. It falls away.
message.bleach.hollow_player.villager: The villager shivers and turns away from something it cannot see.
message.bleach.hollow_player.ravenous: The hunger sharpens. Your wounds close slowly.
message.bleach.hollow_player.starving: You are starving. Devour something, now.
message.bleach.hollow_player.cannot_eat: Food is ash in your mouth. Only souls can feed you.
message.bleach.hollow_player.stir: The %s souls within you stir and press against your hide.
message.bleach.hollow_player.scent: You smell a soul %s, about %s blocks away.
message.bleach.hollow_player.purified_by: The blade passes through your mask. It shatters, and the hunger with it. You are a soul again, at the Academy.
message.bleach.hollow_player.cleansed: A blade cleansed you. You wake as a soul, the hunger gone.
message.bleach.devour.no_target: There is nothing within reach to devour.
message.bleach.devour.no_soul: There is no soul in it worth devouring.
message.bleach.devour.out_of_reach: It is out of reach of your jaws.
message.bleach.devour.protected: That soul is beyond your jaws for now.
message.bleach.devour.too_strong: Its reiatsu is too great to swallow.
message.bleach.devour.not_weak: It is still too strong. Wear it down first.
message.bleach.devour.plus_hint: The Plus pulls itself back together. Hold %s on it to devour it instead.
message.bleach.gnaw.quincy: Your Quincy blood will not let you.
message.bleach.gnaw.off: Your teeth find no purchase on the chain.
message.bleach.gnaw.start: You sink your teeth into your own chain.
message.bleach.gnaw.hint: Something in you wants to finish the job. Hold %s to gnaw at your own chain.
message.bleach.reiatsu_too_weak: You do not have enough reiryoku to release
message.bleach.power_lent: Your power has not returned yet
message.bleach.became_shinigami: Your body is gone, but the Shinigami power within holds your soul together. You are a Shinigami now.
message.bleach.enrolled: You enroll at the Academy. The instructor hands you an Asauchi, a nameless blade.
message.bleach.asauchi_reissued: The instructor hands you a new Asauchi
message.bleach.asauchi_not_yet: The instructor has no blade to spare yet
message.bleach.hell_butterfly.received: You are handed a Jigokuchō, a Hell Butterfly. Carry it, and a Senkaimon will take you between the worlds.
message.bleach.hell_butterfly.issued: The instructor hands you a Jigokuchō
message.bleach.hell_butterfly.not_yet: The instructor has no Jigokuchō to spare yet
message.bleach.graduated: You pass the Academy's exams. You are a Shinigami now.
message.bleach.konso.received: The pommel touches your forehead. Your Chain of Fate falls away and your soul passes on.
message.bleach.konso.untrained: Only a Shinigami can perform Konsō
message.bleach.power.received: Power floods into you and a blade forms in your hands. You are a Substitute Shinigami.
message.bleach.wounded_nearby: You sense a faint, wavering reiatsu nearby. Someone is hurt.
message.bleach.duty_arrives: A Shinigami on duty has come down %s, sent to perform your Konsō.
message.bleach.duty_unreachable: A Shinigami on duty is looking for you, but cannot reach you here. Make your way onto open, dry land.
message.bleach.duty_elsewhere: No Shinigami on duty comes to this world. Return to the Overworld to be found.
message.bleach.duty_holds: No Shinigami on duty comes to this world, but your Chain of Fate holds here. Return to the Overworld to be found.
message.bleach.offer.konso: %s offers to perform Konsō. Your chain will fall away, ending any chance of becoming a Hollow, and your soul will be sent on to the Academy in Soul Society.
message.bleach.offer.konso.nowhere: %s offers to perform Konsō. Your chain will fall away, ending any chance of becoming a Hollow, and your soul will linger here.
message.bleach.offer.konso.rukongai: %s offers to perform Konsō. Your chain will fall away, ending any chance of becoming a Hollow, and your soul will pass on to the Rukongai in Soul Society.
message.bleach.offer.power: %s offers you their Shinigami power. You would keep your body and become a Substitute Shinigami.
message.bleach.offer.hint: Use an empty hand on them within 30 seconds to accept
message.bleach.power.confirm: Use your blade on %s again to lend them your power. You will be left nearly powerless
message.bleach.power.too_weak: Your power is too faint to share
message.bleach.power.given: Your power pours into %s. You are left nearly powerless, and in Soul Society this is a grave crime.
message.bleach.reishi_footing.too_weak: Your spiritual power is too faint to harden the reishi underfoot
message.bleach.reishi_footing.exhausted: The reishi under your feet scatters
message.bleach.flash_step.too_weak: You do not have enough reiryoku to flash step
message.bleach.flash_step.blocked: There is no room to flash step
message.bleach.flash_step.weighed_down: You are weighed down too heavily
message.bleach.sonido.hollow: Only an Arrancar can use Sonído
message.bleach.pesquisa.focus: You still yourself and reach out with Pesquisa
message.bleach.pesquisa.broken: You moved, and your Pesquisa slipped
message.bleach.pesquisa.cooldown: Your Pesquisa is ready again in %s seconds
message.bleach.pesquisa.too_weak: You do not have enough reiryoku for Pesquisa
message.bleach.pesquisa.none: Pesquisa finds no reiatsu within %s blocks
message.bleach.pesquisa.found_one: Pesquisa finds one reiatsu within %1$s blocks, about %2$s blocks %3$s, %4$s
message.bleach.pesquisa.found: Pesquisa finds %1$s reiatsu within %2$s blocks. The strongest, about %3$s blocks %4$s, is %5$s
message.bleach.bala.gathering: You cannot fire a Bala while a Cero gathers
message.bleach.bala.too_weak: You do not have enough reiryoku for a Bala
message.bleach.academy_sensed: You feel the reiatsu of Shinigami %s, about %s blocks away.
message.bleach.academy_sensed.elsewhere: You feel the reiatsu of Shinigami, far away in Soul Society.

message.bleach.academy_direction.elsewhe: The Academy lies in Soul Society
message.bleach.konso.arrived: You arrive before the gates of the Academy, in Soul Society.
message.bleach.konso.rukongai: You wake in Soul Society, in %s.
message.bleach.konso.no_academy: Soul Society cannot be reached. Your soul lingers here, free of its chain.
message.bleach.respawn.academy: Your soul finds its way back to Soul Society, to the gates of the Academy.
message.bleach.respawn.rukongai: Your soul finds its way back to Soul Society, to %s.
message.bleach.respawn.court: Your soul finds its way back to Soul Society, to the Senkaimon court.

message.bleach.academy_way.gate: The Academy lies in Seireitei, by the gate %s %s, about %s blocks away.
message.bleach.first_hollow.coming: Something howls high above you. A hunger has caught your scent.
message.bleach.first_hollow.wounded: A Shinigami stumbles into sight, bleeding. Far above, something howls after her.
message.bleach.first_hollow.retreated: The Hollow tears the sky open and slips away. It will be back for you.
message.bleach.first_hollow.survived: The Hollow is gone, and you are still standing.
message.bleach.hollow.purified: The mask splits and the Hollow dissolves into light. Its soul is sent on
message.bleach.menos.retreat: The Menos Grande pulls itself back into the sky.
message.bleach.menos.gillian: The souls within you surge together and swell. You are a Gillian: a Menos Grande, one face among countless.
message.bleach.menos.adjuchas: One will rises above the clamour of souls within you and tears the rest apart. You are an Adjuchas. Keep devouring Hollows, or sink back into the mass.
message.bleach.menos.adjuchas.undestined: Something in you knows this is as far as it will go.
message.bleach.menos.vasto_lorde: You shed the beast and stand at a person's height, with the strength of a captain of the Gotei 13. You are a Vasto Lorde.
message.bleach.menos.vasto_full: Hueco Mundo holds as many Vasto Lorde as it can bear. You can grow no further for now.
message.bleach.menos.fading: The souls within you stir against your will: devour a Hollow, or sink back into a Gillian. Minutes left: %s.
message.bleach.menos.regressed: Starved of Hollows, your will drowns among the souls within you. You are a Gillian once more.
message.bleach.menos.regressed.lost: Starved of Hollows, your will drowns among the souls within you, and it will not rise again. You are a Gillian once more.
message.bleach.menos.no_room: There is no room here to rise to your full height.
message.bleach.menos.mindless: A Gillian's clouded mind cannot work that.
message.bleach.menos.too_big: You are far too large for that.
message.bleach.cero.not_menos: Only a Menos Grande can gather a Cero. Keep devouring.
message.bleach.cero.devouring: Your jaws are full: you cannot gather a Cero while you devour.
message.bleach.cero.cooldown: Your reiatsu has not gathered again since the last Cero.
message.bleach.cero.too_weak: Too little reiryoku left to gather a Cero.
message.bleach.cero.fizzled: The Cero fizzles out before it has gathered.
message.bleach.cero.held: Held in the light, you cannot gather a Cero.
message.bleach.cero.untrained: Your mask has not been worn long enough to gather its Cero.
message.bleach.cero.unmasked: Put your Hollow mask on to gather a Cero.
message.bleach.gran_rey_cero.held: Held in the light, you cannot gather a Gran Rey Cero.
message.bleach.gran_rey_cero.bound: Your arms are bound: you cannot draw the blood for a Gran Rey Cero.
message.bleach.gran_rey_cero.locked: Espada only. You are %1$s; a seat needs %2$s maximum reiryoku.
message.bleach.gran_rey_cero.cooldown: Your blood has not gathered for another Gran Rey Cero: %s seconds.
message.bleach.gran_rey_cero.no_blade: Hold your own blade to draw the blood for a Gran Rey Cero.
message.bleach.gran_rey_cero.too_weak: Too little reiryoku left for a Gran Rey Cero.
message.bleach.gran_rey_cero.too_hurt: You are too badly hurt to spill blood for a Gran Rey Cero.
message.bleach.gran_rey_cero.fizzled: The Gran Rey Cero scatters before it has gathered. The blood is spent.
message.bleach.negacion.held: Held in the light, you can touch nothing.
message.bleach.negacion.cooldown: The light has not gathered again: %s seconds.
message.bleach.negacion.too_weak: Too little reiryoku left to call down Negación.
message.bleach.negacion.no_target: Look at a comrade to call down Negación.
message.bleach.negacion.not_ally: Negación lifts only Hollows, Arrancar and your own team.
message.bleach.negacion.too_big: That one is far too large for the light.
message.bleach.negacion.busy: That one is already held, or cannot be lifted now.
message.bleach.negacion.offered: %1$s calls down Negación on you. Use the light with %2$s within %3$s seconds to be lifted away, untouchable; sneak to leave it.
message.bleach.negacion.offer_sent: The light falls on %s. They must step into it.
message.bleach.negacion.set_down.spawn: The light carries you away and sets you down at your spawn point.
message.bleach.negacion.set_down.back: The light carries you away, but sets you down where it found you.
message.bleach.caja_negacion.not_espada: Only a seated Espada can use the Caja Negación.
message.bleach.caja_negacion.cooldown: Your Caja Negación is not ready: %s seconds.
message.bleach.caja_negacion.no_hole: The Caja Negación needs a Hollow hole to go into.
message.bleach.caja_negacion.too_big: That one is far too large for the Caja Negación.
message.bleach.caja_negacion.busy: That one is already held, or cannot be shut away now.
message.bleach.caja_negacion.protected: PvP or team rules keep that one from the Caja Negación.
message.bleach.caja_negacion.sees_it: It sees you coming. Get behind it first.
message.bleach.caja_negacion.closed: %1$s is shut away in the Caja Negación for %2$s seconds.
message.bleach.caja_negacion.shut_in: %1$s shuts you inside a Caja Negación. You will tear your way out in %2$s seconds.
message.bleach.caja_negacion.shut_in.nob: You are shut inside a Caja Negación. You will tear your way out in %s seconds.
message.bleach.caja_negacion.held: Shut inside the Caja Negación, you can touch nothing.
message.bleach.caja_negacion.torn_out: You tear your way out of the Caja Negación.
message.bleach.caja_negacion.given: As one of the Espada, you carry a Caja Negación. Use it from behind on a Hollow or an Arrancar within reach to shut them away for a while; it never harms them.
message.bleach.caja_negacion.reissued: A new Caja Negación is in your hands.
message.bleach.caja_negacion.crumbled: The Caja Negación crumbles: it is the Espada's alone.
message.bleach.fraccion.yields: %s kneels. Use it with an empty hand to make it your Fracción.
message.bleach.fraccion.pledged: %1$s kneels and pledges itself to you as your Fracción (%2$s of %3$s).
message.bleach.fraccion.full: You already have %s Fracción. Send one away first.
message.bleach.fraccion.not_espada: Only a seated Espada can take a Fracción.
message.bleach.fraccion.status: %1$s serves you (%2$s of %3$s). Sneak and use it twice to send it away.
message.bleach.fraccion.confirm: Sneak and use it again to send %s away for good.
message.bleach.fraccion.dismissed: %s leaves your service through a Garganta.
message.bleach.fraccion.released: Your Fracción leave you: you are no longer an Arrancar.
message.bleach.arrancar.tear.armed: Press %s again to tear off your mask. There is no going back, and it may fail.
message.bleach.arrancar.tear.started: You dig your claws under your mask and pull. Hold still.
message.bleach.arrancar.tear.broken: You lose your grip on your mask. Nothing is spent.
message.bleach.arrancar.tear.cancelled: You let go of your mask.
message.bleach.arrancar.tear.failed: Your mask will not come away. It cracks, and you with it.
message.bleach.arrancar.tear.not_menos: Only a Menos can tear away its own mask. Keep devouring.
message.bleach.arrancar.tear.mindless: A Gillian has no will of its own to tear its mask with.
message.bleach.arrancar.tear.off: Hollows cannot tear off their own masks on this server.
message.bleach.arrancar.tear.waiting: Your mask has not settled since you last tore at it: %s more minutes.
message.bleach.arrancar.tear.fighting: You need a moment's calm to tear at your mask: %s more seconds.
message.bleach.arrancar.tear.too_weak: You need nearly all your reiryoku to tear off your mask.
message.bleach.arrancar.tear.busy: Finish devouring or gathering your Cero first.
message.bleach.arrancar.became: Your mask tears away. What is left of it hovers on your face, and the torn piece is a blade in your hand: %s. You are an Arrancar.
message.bleach.arrancar.rank.numero: You are Número %s: the Arrancar are numbered in the order they are born.
message.bleach.arrancar.rank.unnumbered: Every Número is taken: you are an Arrancar without a number for now.
message.bleach.arrancar.rank.espada: You are the %2$s Espada (%1$s), one of the ten strongest Arrancar. Your number is tattooed %3$s.
message.bleach.arrancar.rank.lost: You have lost your seat among the Espada, and are %s now.
message.bleach.arrancar.blade.reformed: Your lost blade forms again from your mask: %s.
message.bleach.arrancar.blade.crumbled: An Arrancar's blade crumbles away: its power is not yours to hold.
message.bleach.resurreccion.sealed: Your power is sealed in the blade again
message.bleach.resurreccion.ended: Your power is sealed in the blade again
message.bleach.resurreccion.exhausted: Your reiryoku runs out, and your power seals itself in the blade
message.bleach.resurreccion.no_blade: Hold your own blade to release it
message.bleach.resurreccion.cooldown: Your power has not settled since your last release: %s more seconds
message.bleach.resurreccion.too_weak: You need at least half your reiryoku to release
message.bleach.mask_hint: Your blows barely slow it. Strike the mask.
message.bleach.mask_fragment: A fragment of the mask breaks away.
message.bleach.chain_bitten: The Hollow's bite gnaws at your Chain of Fate
message.bleach.plus_devoured: A Hollow devours a Plus nearby.
message.bleach.plus_hollowfied: A Plus nearby has lost the last of its chain. A mask forms over its face.
message.bleach.plus.speech.0: I keep coming back here. I can't remember why.
message.bleach.plus.speech.1: Have you seen my family? They were here a moment ago.
message.bleach.plus.speech.2: Something is watching us. It's hungry.
message.bleach.plus.speech.3: My chest hurts where the chain goes in.
message.bleach.plus.speech.4: Nobody looks at me any more. You can see me?
message.bleach.plus.speech.5: I'm waiting for someone. They promised they'd come.
message.bleach.plus.farewell.0: The Plus closes its eyes, and its face eases.
message.bleach.plus.farewell.1: "Thank you," the Plus whispers as it sinks away.
message.bleach.plus.farewell.2: The Plus bows, and the light takes it.
message.bleach.plus.farewell.3: "Will it hurt?" it asks. It doesn't.
message.bleach.plus.reformed: Your blow passes through the Plus's soul, and it pulls itself back together
message.bleach.denreishinki.hollowficati: A Plus has turned Hollow %s, about %s blocks away
message.bleach.denreishinki.static: Only static. It answers to a Shinigami's reiatsu
message.bleach.denreishinki.received: You are handed a Denreishinki, a soul pager. It will warn you when Hollows arrive.
message.bleach.bond.whisper.1: Your Asauchi feels warm, as if something inside it turned over.
message.bleach.bond.whisper.2: For a moment you hear breathing that is not your own.
message.bleach.bond.whisper.3: A voice calls from the blade, but the words will not come through.
message.bleach.bond.whisper.4: The voice in your Asauchi is clear now. Sit in Jinzen and listen.
message.bleach.jinzen.off_hand: Empty your off hand to lay the blade across your lap
message.bleach.jinzen.not_grounded: Sit on solid ground for Jinzen
message.bleach.jinzen.cannot: Your soul cannot reach a blade's spirit
message.bleach.jinzen.power_lent: Your power is lent away; the blade is silent
message.bleach.jinzen.not_yours: This blade's spirit belongs to someone else
message.bleach.jinzen.released: Seal your zanpakutō before you sit
message.bleach.jinzen.settling: You lay the blade across your lap and slow your breathing...
message.bleach.zanpakuto.call: Press %s to call it out and release it.
message.bleach.zanpakuto.call_constant: Press %s to call its name. It will never seal again.
message.bleach.zanpakuto.reformed: %s takes shape again in the blade you carry
message.bleach.shikai.no_blade: Hold your zanpakutō to release it
message.bleach.shikai.nameless: This blade has not told you its name
message.bleach.shikai.not_yours: This blade does not answer to you
message.bleach.shikai.settling: Your zanpakutō has not settled yet
message.bleach.shikai.too_weak: Not enough reiryoku to release it
message.bleach.shikai.cannot_seal: Your zanpakutō has no sealed form any more
message.bleach.shikai.exhausted: Out of reiryoku: your zanpakutō seals
message.bleach.shikai.away: Away from your hand, your zanpakutō seals
message.bleach.shikai.first.subtitle: Shikai
message.bleach.getsuga.not_yours: This blade does not answer to you
message.bleach.getsuga.no_technique: This zanpakutō has no such technique
message.bleach.getsuga.too_weak: Not enough reiryoku for a Getsuga Tenshō
message.bleach.getsuga.named: Your zanpakutō speaks: that blow has a name. Call it Getsuga Tenshō.
message.bleach.visored.wound: Hollow reiatsu seeps into your wound, and something inside you stirs (%s of %s).
message.bleach.visored.rooted: Hollow reiatsu has taken root in your soul. A second voice is in your head now, and it wants your body.
message.bleach.visored.speech.voice.1: Every time you bleed, I get a little stronger.
message.bleach.visored.speech.voice.2: That blade of yours would cut better in my hands.
message.bleach.visored.speech.ready: Sit in Jinzen and face me, king. Unless you're scared.
message.bleach.visored.speech.taunt: Back again? Come on, then. Lose some more.
message.bleach.visored.disabled: Hollowfication is turned off on this server.
message.bleach.visored.no_power: Without your Shinigami power, your Hollow is out of reach.
message.bleach.visored.duel.already: You are already facing your Hollow.
message.bleach.visored.duel.peaceful: Your Hollow stays quiet while the world is peaceful.
message.bleach.visored.duel.crowded: Another soul is fighting its Hollow too close by.
message.bleach.visored.begun: Your inner Hollow steps out of you with your own blade. Beat it inside the ring before the time runs out.
message.bleach.visored.speech.begun: Let's see which of us is king.
message.bleach.visored.duel.arena: There is no way out but through your Hollow.
message.bleach.visored.duel.barrier: A barrier keeps you out of another soul's fight.
message.bleach.visored.duel.broken_off: The fight is broken off. Your Hollow will be waiting.
message.bleach.visored.won: Your Hollow is beaten, and you are a Visored. Its power is yours, for as long as you stay its king. Press %s to call its mask.
message.bleach.visored.speech.won: Fine. You're king... for now. Falter, and it's all mine.
message.bleach.visored.lost: Your Hollow beat you down. It will be ready to fight again in %s minutes.
message.bleach.visored.speech.lost: Pathetic. Your body will be mine soon enough.
message.bleach.visored.speech.takeover: Can't let you die yet, king. Move over.
message.bleach.visored.speech.takeover.m: You reached for my power, king. Now it's mine.
message.bleach.visored.speech.takeover.e: Tch. Have it back, king. For now.
message.bleach.visored.speech.fallen: Told you, king. It's all mine now.
message.bleach.visored.mask.not_subdued: Your Hollow is not beaten yet, and its mask is not yours to call.
message.bleach.visored.mask.waiting: Your mask will not form again for %s s.
message.bleach.visored.mask.too_weak: You lack the reiryoku to call your mask.
message.bleach.visored.mask.crumbled: Your mask crumbles away, and your breath comes hard.
message.bleach.visored.mask.dry: Your reiryoku runs dry, and your mask crumbles with it.
message.bleach.visored.mask.shattered: Your mask shatters under the blows.
message.bleach.visored.takeover.sealed: Your Hollow has your body. Tear its mask off to take it back.
message.bleach.visored.takeover.torn_off: You tear the Hollow's mask away and take your body back.
message.bleach.visored.takeover.pinned: The binding pins your Hollow, and it lets go of your body.
message.bleach.visored.takeover.begun: Your Hollow seizes your body. Press %s to tear its mask off and take it back.
message.bleach.visored.fallen: Your Hollow has beaten you once too often, and it swallows your soul. A hole opens in your chest: you have become a Hollow.

message.bleach.kido.lent: Your power is lent: Kidō will not answer to its name alone
message.bleach.kido.too_weak: You do not have enough reiryoku for %s
message.bleach.kido.chant_too_soon: Catch your breath before you chant again
message.bleach.kido.incantation: The incantation of %s, to say whole in chat:

message.bleach.kido.gather_broken: %s is broken before it has gathered

message.bleach.kaido.begun.self: %s: your palms glow green over your own wounds
message.bleach.kaido.no_patient: No one is within reach to heal
message.bleach.kaido.lost: Your patient slips from your hands
message.bleach.kido.lesson: The instructor drills you in the forms of Kidō (+%s Kidō xp).
message.bleach.kido.lesson.next: Your next spell is %s, from Kidō %s.
message.bleach.kido.lesson.incantation: Its incantation, to practise until then:

message.bleach.kido.lesson.quincy: The instructor cannot teach Kidō to a Quincy.
message.bleach.senkaimon.turning: You set your blade in the air and turn it like a key
message.bleach.senkaimon.slipped: The lock slips back, and the Senkaimon stays shut
message.bleach.senkaimon.mount: The Senkaimon takes no mount. Step down to pass
message.bleach.senkaimon.no_power: Only a Shinigami can open a Senkaimon
message.bleach.senkaimon.wrong_world: A Senkaimon opens only between the Human World and Soul Society

message.bleach.senkaimon.no_landing: The far side of the Senkaimon is blocked
message.bleach.dangai.entered: No guide leads you: you are in the Dangai. Follow the lane to its end
message.bleach.dangai.held: The Kōryū's current holds you fast
message.bleach.dangai.thrown: The Kōtotsu caught you and flung you out of the Dangai, far off your course.
message.bleach.dangai.lost: Nothing guided you through the Dangai, and it has let you out in the Human World.
message.bleach.bloodline.quincy: Quincy blood runs in your veins: you are %s
message.bleach.bloodline.human: Your blood is ordinary. Your path lies elsewhere
message.bleach.bloodline.fate_none: Fate gave you no Quincy blood
message.bleach.bloodline.stirs: Something old stirs in your blood
message.bleach.bloodline.cross: A Quincy Cross has been handed down to you
message.bleach.quincy_cross.no_blood: The Cross is only silver to you. There is no Quincy blood in you
message.bleach.quincy_cross.shinigami: A Shinigami's power fills your soul, and the Cross will not answer it
message.bleach.quincy_cross.spirit: The Cross stays cold. Its power belongs to a living Quincy
message.bleach.quincy_cross.fizzle: The reishi gathers in your hand, then slips away
message.bleach.quincy.awakened: Your Quincy power awakens. The Cross forms the Heilig Bogen
message.bleach.quincy.destroyed: The Hollow is destroyed, soul and all
message.bleach.quincy.destroyed_nearby: Nearby, a soul was destroyed instead of being sent on
message.bleach.quincy.reborn: Your Quincy blood holds your soul to your body. You wake, alive
message.bleach.quincy.soul_reformed: Your soul tore apart and knit itself together again. You are alive, and weaker
message.bleach.quincy.chill: A chill runs through your blood
message.bleach.heilig_bogen.too_weak: You have too little reishi to fire
message.bleach.heilig_bogen.collapsed: Your bow comes apart: you have no reishi left
message.bleach.hirenkyaku.untrained: Reishi will not carry you yet
message.bleach.hirenkyaku.too_weak: You have too little reishi for Hirenkyaku
message.bleach.blut.locked: Your blood is not ready for %s
message.bleach.blut.too_weak: You have too little reishi for %s
message.bleach.blut.dry: Your reishi runs out and your blood settles
message.bleach.hollow_poison.25: Hollow reiatsu seeps into your blood
message.bleach.hollow_poison.50: Hollow poison clouds your reishi. Hirenkyaku and Blut will not answer
message.bleach.hollow_poison.75: The poison is reaching your soul
message.bleach.hollow_poison.cured: A purified soul's light washes some of the poison away
message.bleach.sanrei_glove.given: Your blood has come of age, and a Sanrei Glove is handed down to you. Wear it and train through the strain, a little every day.
message.bleach.sanrei_glove.tier: Only a Quincy of the third tier can bear the Sanrei Glove.
message.bleach.sanrei_glove.stage: Your power has already gone past the glove.
message.bleach.sanrei_glove.powerless: You cannot call on your Quincy power now.
message.bleach.sanrei_glove.already_worn: You are already wearing the Sanrei Glove.
message.bleach.sanrei_glove.put_on: You pull on the Sanrei Glove. Every draw will fight you now. Press %s to take it off.
message.bleach.sanrei_glove.strain: The glove's strain pulls the bow apart.
message.bleach.sanrei_glove.day: A day's training with the glove counts: %s of %s.
message.bleach.sanrei_glove.mastered: The Sanrei Glove no longer fights you. Press %s twice to tear it off and burn your power out: Letzt Stil.
message.bleach.sanrei_glove.removed: You take off the Sanrei Glove.
message.bleach.letzt_stil.armed: Press %s again to tear the glove off. Your power will burn out.
message.bleach.letzt_stil.disabled: Letzt Stil is turned off on this server.
message.bleach.letzt_stil.once: A soul can burn its power out only once.
message.bleach.letzt_stil.powerless: You cannot call on your Quincy power now.
message.bleach.letzt_stil.poisoned: Hollow poison clouds your power too much to burn it.
message.bleach.letzt_stil.no_glove: Letzt Stil needs the mastered Sanrei Glove on your hand.
message.bleach.letzt_stil.sealed_release: With your Quincy power sealed, you have no reiatsu to release.
message.bleach.letzt_stil.sealed_now: Your Quincy power is gone. After %s it can return: worn down to near collapse, hold the Cross through a long rite, or let another Quincy's arrow find the place beside your heart.
message.bleach.letzt_stil.sealed_now_arr: Your Quincy power is gone. After %s it can return: worn down to near collapse, let another Quincy's arrow find the place beside your heart.
message.bleach.rite.too_soon: Your power is not ready to return yet (%s).
message.bleach.rite.not_exhausted: The rite needs a body worn to its limit: low health and an empty stomach.
message.bleach.rite.thin: The reishi here is too thin for the rite.
message.bleach.rite.broken: You let go too soon. The rite breaks.
message.bleach.quincy.restored: Your Quincy power returns, changed: Ginrei Kojaku. Hold a full draw to stream arrows, press %s mid-draw for Licht Regen, and form blades with Seele Schneider.
message.bleach.quincy.restored_other: Your arrow found the place beside %s's heart. Their power returns.
message.bleach.ginto.fill_tier: Filling a Gintō takes a Quincy of the second tier.
message.bleach.ginto.powerless: You cannot call on your Quincy power now.
message.bleach.ginto.no_target: There is nothing there for the spell.
message.bleach.sprenger.no_formation: Sprenger needs five of your Seele Schneider standing in a pentagon nearby.
message.bleach.sprenger.formed: Five blades stand. A Gintō set to Sprenger will set them off.
message.bleach.sprenger.broken: The formation broke before Sprenger went off.
message.bleach.vollstandig.unlocked: Your restored power has outgrown its shape. Press %s to take your full form: Vollständig.
message.bleach.vollstandig.cooldown: Your power settles. Vollständig again in %s.
message.bleach.vollstandig.poisoned: Hollow poison clouds your power too much for Vollständig.
message.bleach.vollstandig.powerless: You cannot call on your Quincy power now.
message.bleach.vollstandig.dry: Your reishi runs out and the form falls away.
message.bleach.vollstandig.halo_broken: Your halo shatters. Sklaverei is beyond you for now.
message.bleach.sklaverei.on: Sklaverei: the reishi around you bends to you.
message.bleach.quincy_form.sealed: Your power is sealed. It can return in %s.
message.bleach.quincy_form.sealed_ready: Your power could return now: worn to your limit, hold the Cross through the rite.
message.bleach.quincy_form.sealed_ready_: Your power could return now: worn to your limit, let another Quincy's full-draw arrow find the place beside your heart.
message.bleach.quincy_form.nothing: There is nothing more to call on yet.
message.bleach.bait.crushed: The bait crumbles, and its scent spreads. Hollows will come.
message.bleach.bait.refused.unaware: You cannot sense what this would draw.
message.bleach.bait.refused.hollow: Your own reiatsu already calls them.
message.bleach.bait.refused.wrong_world: Hollows only come through to the Human World.
message.bleach.bait.refused.quiet: No Hollows can come through here now.
message.bleach.bait.refused.first_hollow: Something is already coming for you.
message.bleach.bait.refused.owned: Your last bait is still drawing them.
message.bleach.bait.refused.academy: Not this close to the Academy.
message.bleach.bait.refused.too_close: Another bait is drawing Hollows nearby.
message.bleach.bait.refused.too_many: Too many baits are drawing Hollows already.
message.bleach.bait.refused.others: Others nearby would be caught up in it.
message.bleach.bait.finale: The sky above the bait cracks open.
message.bleach.bait.ended.expired: The bait's scent fades. No more Hollows come.
message.bleach.bait.ended.finale: The great tear closes, and the Hollows are drawn up into it.
message.bleach.elder.arrives: An old Quincy in white is watching you.
message.bleach.elder.lesson: The Elder corrects your stance and your breathing. (+%s training)
message.bleach.hunter.arrives: Someone else is hunting the Hollows here.
message.bleach.hunter.greet.rivalry: "Another Quincy? Let's see what you can do."
message.bleach.hunter.greet.challenge: "A Shinigami. Of course you'd turn up."
message.bleach.hunter.leaves.hurt: "So that's how it is." He is gone in a flash.
message.bleach.contest.start: The contest is on: whoever destroys more Hollows in %s minutes wins.
message.bleach.contest.won: You destroyed %s to his %s. He hands over a Hollow Bait, scowling.
message.bleach.contest.lost: You destroyed %s to his %s. "As I expected."
message.bleach.ransotengai.woven: Threads of reishi take hold of your limbs.
message.bleach.ransotengai.collapse: The threads let go, and your body gives out.
message.bleach.ransotengai.dry: Your reiryoku runs dry, and the threads snap.
message.bleach.ransotengai.refused.seale: Your power cannot weave the threads now.
message.bleach.ransotengai.refused.coold: Your body needs rest before the threads will hold again (%s).
message.bleach.ransotengai.refused.reiry: Too little reiryoku to weave the threads.
message.bleach.ransotengai.trial_open: "Move your body with reishi alone." Sneak and press %s.
message.bleach.ransotengai.trial_failed: The threads would not hold. Try again.
